title: 3I/ATLAS: review of JPL solution 54
description: Unpromoted orbital projection of the original 3I/ATLAS case. Numerical elements and formal uncertainties are bound to a pinned JPL orbit solution. Broader cometary and origin claims remain in the archived original and are not validated by this projection.
stop_reason: Supporting dependencies are absent from the selected committed canonical baseline, and original claim-level evidence gaps remain. See claim_coverage.json and canonical_comparison.json for exact next actions. Do not promote.
definitions: JPL orbit solution 54, solution date 2026-02-19 09:10:47 as returned by the source.
formal 1-sigma element uncertainties; full covariance at its declared TDB epoch
assumptions: The signed semimajor axis relation applies to osculating elements at the declared epoch.
The source model includes fitted nongravitational A1, A2, A3 and DT parameters; a conservative two-body propagation is not asserted.
Formal fitted uncertainties are not a bound on every systematic model error.

evidence.notes: Published JPL orbit determination. Response metadata and covariance are preserved in the adjacent source manifest and raw snapshot.

falsification_conditions: STOP if object identity, solution id, epoch, frame, units, uncertainty or digest does not match the pinned source.
FAIL if the semimajor-axis identity or covariance-based uncertainty is inconsistent within declared numerical rounding tolerances.
confusion_guard: Passing this orbital audit cannot promote cometary morphology, origin or artificial-object claims, and cannot establish force-free propagation.
